import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Load customers from SQLite
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_169/context/db/customers.db')
customers_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT CustomerID, Segment FROM customers", conn)
conn.close()

# Load yearmonth data
yearmonth_df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_169/context/csv/yearmonth.csv')

# Join on CustomerID
merged_df = pd.merge(yearmonth_df, customers_df, on='CustomerID', how='inner')

# Filter for SME segment and year 2013 (Date format is YYYYMM)
sme_2013_df = merged_df[(merged_df['Segment'] == 'SME') & (merged_df['Date'].astype(str).str.startswith('2013'))]

# Calculate average monthly consumption
avg_consumption = sme_2013_df['Consumption'].mean()

print(f"Average monthly consumption for SME customers in 2013: {avg_consumption}")
print(f"Number of records: {len(sme_2013_df)}")
